Chapter 273: Chapter 17: Trinity (Seeking Subscriptions)

Chapter 273: Chapter 17: Trinity (Seeking Subscriptions)

Mount Morality Immortal stood majestic and grand.

It stood at the center of the Central Divine Continent, like a colossal pillar supporting the heavens.

In fact, for tens of thousands of years, the Daode Immortal Sect had been situated upon this mountain, overlooking all beings from its lofty height.

However, today.

The pillar that countless cultivators of the Central Divine Continent looked up to, was now ‘submerged’ in surging vital energy.

The sound of rushing water echoed.

...

Brilliant and shocking vital energy, mighty and overwhelming, collided fiercely with the Sect Protection Array of Mount Morality Immortal.

At every instant, a vast amount of vital energy evaporated while also causing numerous sections of the Sect Protection Array to collapse.

Still.

The ‘submerging’ vital energy engulfing Mount Morality Immortal did not show any signs of slowing, seeming endless and boundless.

“What’s going on?”

“Has someone dared to attack the Daode Immortal Sect?”

“This red vastness is the power of vital energy? How can there be such immense vital energy?”

Most of the Daode Immortal Sect disciples had yet to react.

Just moments ago, they were cultivating in their own caves, and the next, they felt terrifying fluctuations coming from the direction of the Cloud Mist Blessed Land.

Then.

This was the scene they were faced with now.

The grand Mount Morality Immortal had been ‘submerged’ in surging vital energy, and at this moment, countless formations within the mountain were activated, resisting the erosion of the vital energy.

“Did it hold?”

Upon seeing this, Sect Leader Mu Qingliu, not knowing why, felt a sigh of relief deep inside.

Jun Wuji….

Mu Qingliu’s expression was grave as he looked towards the depths of the red ocean. He could feel that Jun Wuji was there, silently watching Mount Morality Immortal.

“Sect Leader, what exactly happened?”

At that moment, Mu Mengting rushed over, hurriedly asking.

His face looked pale as he glanced at the red twilight enveloping Mount Morality Immortal, unable to suppress the trembling in his heart.

If it weren’t for the sect’s great formations shielding them, with his early Refine Void stage strength, he probably would have been ‘melted’ by the red twilight in no time.

“It’s Jun Wuji.”

Mu Qingliu spoke tersely.

At this moment, he did not want to say much. Daode Immortal Sect was facing the greatest crisis in tens of thousands of years, and most of his attention was on maintaining the Sect Protection Array.

“Jun Wuji?”

“The youngest son of Jun Dongjin?”

“Wasn’t he spiritless?”

Mu Mengting had already seen the person confronting Mu Qingliu and, with the abilities of an Ancient Saint of Refinement Void, identifying him wasn’t difficult.

But the greater this certainty, the more incredulous Mu Mengting became.

Jun Wuji?

The very Jun Wuji he had never even considered a threat?

How could he be so strong?

How could he be so strong?

Mu Mengting couldn’t accept it.

It was as if an ant he had never bothered to glance at had suddenly become a god capable of reaching the heavens, this reversal nearly inducing a Heart Demon in Mu Mengting.

“How would I know.”

Mu Qingliu spared Mu Mengting a glance.

That was indeed the case.

The one now blocking the entrance to Daode Immortal Sect and almost suppressing Mount Morality Immortal with his singular might…

was none other than his former grandson,

an individual who had always been inconspicuous and had never received much attention, a third-generation immortal.

…

The rumble of thunder reverberated.

Boundless vital energy spread out.

Lin Yuan slowly emerged, overlooking the entirety of Mount Morality Immortal.

At this moment, Mount Morality Immortal unleashed its formidable potential under his gaze, defensive formations sparking to life, intermingling and blending with one another, and connecting with the ley lines of the Central Divine Continent.

“Jun Wuji?”

Mu Mengting looked up at the figure above, his thoughts turbulent.

“Jun Wuji?”

“Is he Jun Wuji?”

“The youngest son of Lord Jun Dongjin?”

Countless Daode Immortal Sect disciples also saw Lin Yuan, stunned and unprepared for the entity displaying such overwhelming combat power to be the third-generation immortal who had grown up on Mount Morality Immortal.

Many of the disciples had interacted with Jun Wuji before. At that time, Jun Wuji, with his powerful background, was untouchable, yet he was incapable of cultivation and thus looked down upon by many of the sect’s disciples.

But now.

Looking up at Jun Wuji, who stood high above like a True Immortal from the upper realms, many disciples felt as if they were dreaming.

…

“Let’s see if we can break through.”

Lin Yuan observed Mount Morality Immortal closely below.

Merely eroding it with vital energy was insufficient to handle Daode Immortal Sect; Lin Yuan needed to take action himself.

Boom!!

Lin Yuan raised his hand.

He shot his hand toward Mount Morality Immortal from afar.

Hum!!!

The red twilight rolled, endless vital energy concentrated, forming a hundred-mile wide hand that smacked down toward Mount Morality Immortal.

…

Inside the sleeve space.

Jun Dongjin, Mu Lian’er, along with Jun Xiaoyao and Jun Zhilan, a family, were anxious.

“Husband, what exactly is going on?”

Mu Lian’er asked softly, her mind tense ever since she was taken into the sleeve space.

Although Mu Lian’er was sure that the one who took them away must be her younger son, Jun Wuji,

it only led to more questions.

Why could her younger son take them away?

Why did the Divinity Transformation Stage Heaven Lord guardians outside not stop him?

And could such top-grade immortal techniques as Sleeve Universe, which only Divinity Transformation Stage Heaven Lords can execute, be performed by him?

One question after another deeply puzzled Mu Lian’er.

“My little brother… when did he become so strong? Even Sleeve Universe has been executed by him?”

Jun Zhilan couldn’t help but speak out.

In her eyes, her little brother Jun Wuji had always been someone she needed to protect. Now, he suddenly used Sleeve Universe, a technique exclusively for Heaven Lords…

Jun Zhilan herself was only at the Nascent Soul Stage… Despite this, she was considered a genius within the sect.

“Could it be that my little brother has some hidden Spirit Root, has been secretly cultivating, and now that he’s entered the Divinity Transformation Phase, he has finally asked the Sect Master to take us away?”

Jun Xiaoyao speculated after a moment.
